description: Station de réparation vélo - Ville de Biarritz is a dataset listed in Mairie de Biarritz : Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Biarritz - Service Mobilités et Service Espaces Publics. Localisation des stations de réparation de vélos dans la ville de Biarritz. Coverage: Biarritz. The portal files it under Mobilité, Déplacements. Its keywords are Vélo, station, réparation. The portal shows 2 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-06-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-biarritz-fr-portal.
